prompt: Arrange the body of a census worker: count words in its own lines, add to the shared total, then hand its map to the collector. One line does not belong.
lines: let mut local: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
explain: Each worker builds a private map with no locking, adds its word count to the shared total once, and sends the map over the channel at the end. After `send`, the map has moved, so anything that gives it away earlier breaks the counting.
